answer: Rank identities with short random walks: each epoch, trust flows from audited seed agents like a lantern carried a few hops along co-signed payment edges. Walks wander only five steps, so a sybil cluster linked to honest agents by few edges catches almost none of it, however many fakes it spawns. Rewards scale with trust received, not head count. A zephyr of new keys earns nothing; the attacker must buy real trade edges with honest agents, each costing paid work.
